description: This file contains unit tests for the product-related API endpoints in a Django application, focusing on listing, searching, filtering, ordering, and access control for products.
external_files: Django testing and API client related modules

methods.name: test_products_public_list_only_active(api_client, item_factory)
methods.description: Tests that only active products are listed for public API access.

methods.name: test_products_admin_can_see_inactive_on_list(api_client, item_factory, auth_headers_for_admin)
methods.description: Verifies that admin users can see inactive products in the list.

methods.name: test_products_search_filter_ordering(api_client, item_factory)
methods.description: Tests searching, filtering by SKU, and ordering products.

methods.name: test_products_write_requires_admin(api_client, item_factory, make_test_image_file, auth_headers_for_user, auth_headers_for_admin)
methods.description: Checks that only admins can create, update, or delete products.

methods.name: test_products_public_retrieve_blocks_inactive(api_client, item_factory)
methods.description: Ensures that inactive products cannot be retrieved publicly.
